Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
An empty vampire with Talbot's Chainsaw is stuck. The only action it can
take, hunting, is prohibited by the Chainsaw. If another vampire gives it
blood somehow then it will be able to act normally.

Tom Wylie rec.games.trading-cards.* Network Representative for

Messages.Author: Daniel Hoffman
Messages.Body:
>I have a question regarding Talbot's Chainsaw. The card appears to saw
that the> wielder is forced to attack another minion whenever the wielder is
untapped. >If the wielder goes into torpor and is later brought out by
another vampire it>enters the active region untapped with no blood. It
should be restricted to>only being able to hunt. However since it has the
chainsaw it cannot hunt. However it must attack a vampire since it is
untapped and active. Which 'must'>takes precedence.

My understanding of the rules is that if a vampire has no blood, it can take
no other action other than hunt. Since it cannot hunt, it can take NO
action. You would have to hand off the Chainsaw to one of your other
vampires or leave the vampire with the Chainsaw in torpor less it go
arounding inflicting 3 damage on your other vampires every turn.

Messages.Author: Rick Mc Leod
Messages.Body:

>
>An empty vampire with Talbot's Chainsaw is stuck. The only action it can
>take, hunting, is prohibited by the Chainsaw. If another vampire gives it
>blood somehow then it will be able to act normally.
>

Just an opinion...but I don't think so. The rule about hunting is in the
rule book. There's also a rule about cards that conflict with the rule
book take precedence.

I'd say an empty vampire can blaze away with TC with impunity (for a little
while)
